title: Pokémon Detective Pikachu
tagline: Ryme City, where people and Pokémon live side by side.
about: A young man teams up with his missing father's coffee-loving, hat-wearing Pikachu, the only Pokémon he can understand, to find out what happened.
cue: Serve the chicken and waffles when Tim and Pikachu walk into the Hi-Hat Cafe.
faces: Harry Goodman's partner. Fill the card, win a cup. Easy.
Psyduck's sweet corn fritters with avocado smash
Psyduck explodes when stressed. Golden corn fritters, lime avocado smash.
Mr Mime's grilled cheese with tomato soup shots
Mr Mime is silent but annoying. Toasted cheese fingers, little cups of tomato soup.
Sweet Mother of Arceus lemon sundae
Sweet Mother of Arceus. Vanilla ice cream, lemon curd, honeycomb bolts.
Hi-Hat Cafe fried chicken and waffles with maple butter
Jigglypuff sings a customer to sleep. Buttermilk fried chicken, waffles, maple butter.
Charizard's flame-grilled beef skewers with rice
Charizard takes Pikachu's hat. Sticky soy beef skewers, rice, crunchy slaw.
Pikachu slurps a piping hot coffee. Espresso, hot chocolate, steamed milk. Kids skip the coffee.

Golden corn fritters, lime avocado smash.How to make it2 corn cobs, kernels cut off100g self-raising flour2 eggs80ml milk2 spring onions, sliced50g tasty cheese, grated3 tbsp olive oil2 ripe avocados1 limeWhisk the flour, eggs and milk into a thick batter, then stir in the corn, spring onion, cheese and a pinch of salt.Mash the avocados with the lime juice and a little salt.Fry heaped spoonfuls in the oil until golden, about 2 minutes a side.Drain and serve with the avocado smash.Mr Mime's grilled cheese with tomato soup shotsMr Mime is silent but annoying. Toasted cheese fingers, little cups of tomato soup.How to make it1 brown onion, chopped2 tbsp olive oil2 x 400g tins of crushed tomatoes250ml vegetable stock1 tsp caster sugar60ml pouring cream8 slices of white sandwich bread150g tasty cheese, grated40g soft butterSoften the onion in the oil, add the tomatoes, stock and sugar and simmer for 15 minutes.Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season.Fill the bread with cheese, butter the outsides and toast in a pan until golden and melted.Cut into fingers and serve with small cups of soup for dipping.A bowl of salted pretzelsFor the stakeout.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.PlatesHi-Hat Cafe fried chicken and waffles with maple butterJigglypuff sings a customer to sleep. Buttermilk fried chicken, waffles, maple butter.How to make it8 chicken tenderloins375ml buttermilk, plus 250ml for the waffles150g plain flour, plus 200g for the waffles1 tsp sweet paprika1 tsp garlic powder1 L vegetable oil, for frying2 tsp baking powder2 eggs60g butter, melted, plus 60g soft3 tbsp maple syrup, plus extra to serveSoak the chicken in 375ml buttermilk with a pinch of salt for at least 20 minutes.Whisk the waffle flour, baking powder, eggs, 250ml buttermilk and melted butter and cook in a hot waffle iron until crisp.Toss the chicken in the flour mixed with paprika, garlic powder and salt, and fry at 175°C until golden and cooked through.Beat the soft butter with the maple syrup.Stack the chicken on the waffles, top with maple butter and pour over extra syrup.Charizard's flame-grilled beef skewers with riceCharizard takes Pikachu's hat. Sticky soy beef skewers, rice, crunchy slaw.How to make it600g rump steak, in cubes3 tbsp soy sauce2 tbsp honey1 tbsp sesame oil2 garlic cloves, crushed1 red capsicum, in chunks300g jasmine rice1/4 red cabbage, finely shredded1 carrot, grated1 lime8 bamboo skewers, soakedMix the soy, honey, sesame oil and garlic, toss with the beef and leave for 15 minutes.Cook the rice.Thread the beef and capsicum onto the skewers.Grill on a hot barbecue or grill pan, turning, until charred and sticky, brushing with the leftover marinade.Toss the cabbage and carrot with lime juice and serve with the skewers and rice.The Cake CaseSweet Mother of Arceus lemon sundaeSweet Mother of Arceus. Vanilla ice cream, lemon curd, honeycomb bolts.How to make it1 L vanilla ice cream250g lemon curd100g honeycomb, broken into shards300ml thickened cream8 plain sweet biscuits, crushedWhip the cream to soft peaks.Layer crushed biscuits, ice cream and lemon curd in 4 tall glasses.Top with cream and stick in shards of honeycomb like lightning bolts.Cups and ShakesPikachu's piping hot mochaPikachu slurps a piping hot coffee. Kids skip the coffee.How to make it4 shots of espresso, or 4 tsp instant coffee4 tbsp drinking chocolate750ml milk4 tbsp whipped cream1 tsp cocoa powderHeat the milk until steaming and whisk in the drinking chocolate.Pour a shot of espresso into each grown-up mug, top up with the chocolate milk and finish with cream and a dusting of cocoa.Iced water with lemonOn the house, detective.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
